payload.title: GHA-PR-LLM-AC-003: Extract acceptance criteria from GitHub issue bodies
payload.body:
## Summary

Deterministically extract discrete acceptance criteria from issue markdown when structured (e.g. `### Acceptance criteria`, `- [ ]` checklists), with a defined fallback when structure is missing so the user-visible output still lists criteria to address.

## Scope

- In scope: Parsing/normalization of checklist items and heading-based sections; stable IDs or ordering for downstream LLM mapping; handling “no extractable AC” per PRD journey (message to improve issue template).
- Out of scope: Final PR comment formatting (downstream), LLM vendor calls.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Given an issue whose body contains a markdown **checklist** of AC items, when analyzed, then the pipeline produces a **discrete list** that matches those items (wording may be normalized but meaning preserved).
- [ ] Given an issue with an **Acceptance criteria** section (per agreed heading convention), criteria under it are extracted preferentially over free-form body text.
- [ ] Given an issue with **no** recognizable structure, the pipeline returns a clear **“no extractable acceptance criteria”** outcome for downstream steps to surface in the PR comment (per PRD §3 journey 3).
- [ ] Unit tests cover checklist extraction, section extraction, and empty/unstructured cases.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: GHA-PR-LLM-AC-001
- Blocks: GHA-PR-LLM-AC-005

## Notes

If fallback uses LLM for segmentation, keep it behind the same cost controls as GHA-PR-LLM-AC-007 once that exists; until then, document any interim limits.

PRD: https://github.com/hyperjumptech/mediapulse/blob/prds/pr-github-llm-ticket-acceptance.prd.md
